salesforce.title: Agentforce editions, side by side
salesforce.intro: Announced September 3, 2026 and live on Salesforce's Sales Cloud pricing page as of September 30. All three bill annually per user, per month.

rows.label: Bundled extras
values: Core + enhanced security, more AI, expanded data capacity

salesforce.footnote: This is separate from the standalone $125/user/month Agentforce add-on covered in our earlier entries — Salesforce hasn't clarified how the two relate.

figma.title: Full seat price by plan
figma.intro: Figma's per-seat pricing varies by plan tier and seat type. Full seats include Figma Design, Dev Mode, FigJam, and Figma Slides.
figma.footnote: Organization and Enterprise lost monthly billing entirely in the March 2025 overhaul — only Professional still offers it.
